root_idea.summary: The root's semantic field centers on attending to or recognizing something, especially through an apparent marker that makes something otherwise hidden knowable.
root_idea.development: The evidence also records related developments of pausing or awaiting, acting deliberately, and deliberately directing oneself toward a person or object. These root-level developments do not constitute meanings of every derived form.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole QAC group is the Quran-attested nominal آيَة and its inflected forms; these are normalized under the singular dictionary citation form.

senses.definition: An apparent sign, indication, evidence, or proof by which something otherwise not directly perceived is recognized.
senses.usage_conditions: Applies to sensible or intelligible signs and to a sign regarded as inseparable from what it reveals.

senses.definition: A miraculous or wondrous sign, especially a divinely sent portent.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of extraordinary signs and wonders, including signs sent to peoples as admonition or warning.

senses.definition: An instructive example or warning that serves as a lesson.
senses.usage_conditions: May refer to a narrated person, event, or divinely presented case insofar as it functions as an exemplary warning; this is distinct from the bounded verse sense.

senses.definition: A verse or distinct bounded passage of Quranic revelation.
senses.usage_conditions: Refers to a connected portion of the Quran at which recitation or speech may properly break; the plural commonly denotes the revealed verses collectively.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put or set a sign, token, or mark by which a person or thing may be known.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II verbal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To chide or urge camels by calling to them with a repeated cry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized verbal use in addressing camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pause, stay, remain, tarry, or restrain oneself; also to wait for something and act deliberately or leisurely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes remaining or confining oneself in a place and conducting oneself without haste.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To direct one's course or aim toward a person's body, visible form, or person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form VI use; the object may be the person or the person's visible corporeal form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vocative particle used to call or address someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Its use and range of address vary among authorities; it may occur before a personal name or expression of address.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An explicative particle meaning “that is,” “namely,” or “meaning.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Introduces an explanation, clarification, or substitute for what precedes it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A reply particle meaning “yes,” “indeed,” or “yea,” affirming the truth of an assertion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Commonly precedes an oath, especially in the formula إِىْ وَرَبِّي or إِىْ وَاللّٰهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An interrogative determiner or pronoun meaning “which,” “who,” or “what.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Selects a person or thing from a set and is used with intellectual beings as well as non-intellectual things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A conditional selector meaning “whichever,” “whatever,” or “any … that.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of persons or things in conditional constructions, including expressions equivalent to “wherever.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A relative or conjunct noun meaning “the one who,” “the one which,” or “which of them.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Requires a complement or following proposition and can function in constructions comparable to الَّذِي.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An intensive epithet expressing perfection, completeness, or an exceptional degree of a quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a noun in expressions of admiration or wonder; this use is figurative.

other_classical_meanings.definition: With ك prefixed, “how many” or “many a.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The following noun commonly functions as a specification, often with مِنْ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A connective used with يَا to address a noun made definite by ال, a demonstrative, or a relative expression.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in formulas such as يَا أَيُّهَا الرَّجُلُ and يَا أَيَّتُهَا الْمَرْأَةُ; the feminine form is أَيَّتُهَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The light, radiance, rays, or halo of the sun; by extension, the beauty and brightness of vegetation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The vegetation use is figurative and concerns the brilliance of its verdure, growth, or blossoms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person belonging to a particular district, city, town, or region.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a relational designation when asking or stating from what locality someone comes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An interrogative adverb meaning “when?”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Concerns time rather than place and is used to ask about the time of an event.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A signal or marker used to designate the time or occasion of an action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In constructions such as بِآيَةِ كَذَا, it may govern or introduce a following verbal expression in the sense “at the sign or time of ….”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A message or communication sent from one person or party to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Arabic nominal use distinct from the sign, miracle, example, and Quranic-verse branches.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person's visible body, form, figure, or person perceived from a distance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to the corporeal appearance or individual as seen, rather than to a sign that points beyond itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A whole company or group of people, with none left behind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the expression خَرَجَ القَوْمُ بِآيَتِهِمْ, “the people went forth with their whole company.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vocative particle used to call or address someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A variant of the vocative forms أَيْ and أَ; it is not the nominal آيَة.

cautions: Lane matching uses a contracted/geminate root representation and therefore includes several homographic particles, derived verbs, and unrelated headwords; these have been kept separate by headword rather than assigned to آيَة.
Historical Quran citations appearing inside Lane's particle discussions are not converted into modern verse locations; the Quran examples shown here use only independently supplied QAC locations.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: Lane entry 7572 contains a tentative derivation of إِيَّا from the Form VI verb in addition to a pointer; this speculative etymological proposal was not treated as an independently established meaning.
